privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.updated: This policy explains how Young Engineers handles pre-registration data.
privacy.s1.title: Who is responsible?
privacy.s1.text: Young Engineers, a robotics and technology club based in Gabès (Tunisia). Contact: {email}.
privacy.s2.title: What data do we collect?
privacy.s2.text: Through the pre-registration form, filled in by the parent or guardian: parent or guardian name, young person's first name and age, parent's phone number and email, preferred language, areas of interest, experience level, an optional message, and the date and fact of consent. We do not ask for the young person's family name, postal address or photo.
privacy.s3.title: Why?
privacy.s3.text: Only to record and manage pre-registrations, gauge interest in the club, contact parents and announce the club launch.
privacy.s4.title: Who can access it?
privacy.s4.text: Only authenticated club managers in the private administration area. Data is not sold, published or sent to any external service. One registrant's information is never visible to another visitor.
privacy.s5.title: For how long?
privacy.s5.text: Data is kept for as long as needed to launch the club and for no more than {months} months after pre-registration, unless you ask for earlier deletion. It is then deleted.
privacy.s6.title: Your rights
privacy.s6.text: You may ask to view, correct or delete your pre-registration data, or withdraw your consent, at any time by writing to {email}. Please include the pre-registration number you received after submitting the form.
privacy.s7.title: Security
privacy.s7.text: Administrator access is protected by a hashed password and login attempt limits, with protection against forged submissions (CSRF), parameterised queries and restricted access to the database. No IP address is stored in clear text.
privacy.s8.title: Cookies
privacy.s8.text: The site only uses a technical session cookie (chosen language, form security). No advertising cookies or tracking tools are used.
